results.title: Replika Alternatives: 8 Best AI Companions in 2026
results.content:
## Best for uncensored chat — Candy AI

If you are leaving precisely because Replika stripped out romance and intimacy, you need a companion without heavy censorship. The honest category leader is Candy AI: the consensus #1 in the niche overall, with the strongest image generation, solid conversation quality, and a broad feature set for roughly $6–13 a month. It is a direct, adult replacement for what Replika once did and then took away.

In the same category, OurDream and Nomi are worth a look if visuals and photo generation matter more to you. If you need an adult format specifically inside Telegram, Nika handles NSFW right inside its main product — no separate app or subdomain — though as a pure explicit-content generator Candy is still stronger. [...] A stripped-back free tier. Replika's free version is essentially "friend" mode only: basic chat, partial avatar customization, and a message limit. Romance, roleplay, and advanced features sit behind the subscription.

One barrier too many. Like nearly every competitor, Replika asks you to download an app, create an account, and finish onboarding before you say a single word. Below we show an alternative with none of that friction.

## Replika alternatives compared

Eight options side by side. "Telegram" means the companion runs natively inside the messenger — no separate app, no account creation. Prices are approximate per-month figures and vary by region and promotions. [...] ### Are AI companions safe?

Reliable services encrypt your messages, let you delete them, and have a clear privacy policy — check that and the billing flow. And remember: an AI companion is a complement to life, not a replacement for human support. If you are going through something heavy, it is better to reach out to a person you trust or a professional than to a bot.

## The bottom line

Replika opened the genre, but in 2026 it has plenty of worthy alternatives — and the "best" one depends on what specifically let you down. Want the adult chat Replika cut? Candy AI. Memory that holds? Nomi or Kindroid. A big free ceiling? Character.AI or Kupid. A whole story world? Aurora City.

results.title: Top 5 Replika Alternatives in 2026 (Free & Uncensored)
results.content:
Nastia : Uncensored AI companion with persistent memory, voice calls, image generation, video, and full character customization. NSFW built in, and ERP here to stay. Free to start.
 Character AI : Popular for character creation and roleplay, but heavily censored with strict NSFW filters. Good for SFW creative writing.
 ChatGPT : Powerful general-purpose AI, but designed as a productivity tool, not a companion. NSFW content is blocked entirely.
 Romantic AI : Focused on romantic interactions but limited customization and conversation depth compared to Nastia.
 Chai : Community-driven chatbot platform with user-created characters. Limited NSFW support and inconsistent quality.
 Nomi AI : Newer AI companion with some uncensored features, but smaller community and less mature platform. [...] Replika Free: Basic censored chat with limited messages per day. No NSFW content, no advanced AI model, no voice calls. Avatar accessories and personality customization require microtransaction purchases (gemstones). 100 gemstones cost $14.99.

Replika Pro ($19.99/mo): Unlocks the advanced AI model, ERP for eligible accounts, and some customization. Voice calls included but limited to preset voices. No image generation beyond 3D avatar poses.

Replika Ultra/Platinum/MAX ($49.99–$149.99/mo): Higher tiers add priority access, more advanced features, and premium AI capabilities. The MAX tier is associated with Replika’s newest product and costs up to $149.99/month, more expensive than ChatGPT Plus and most other AI services combined. [...] ## Why Former Replika Users Choose Nastia

Replika and Nastia are both AI companion apps, but they take fundamentally different approaches to what an AI companion should be. Replika started as an open, emotionally intelligent chatbot but has gradually moved toward stricter content filters, scripted responses, and a complex multi-tier pricing model. Nastia was built from the ground up as an uncensored companion platform with persistent memory, voice calls, image generation, and full character customization.

Whether you are searching for a Replika alternative, a Replika alternative for NSFW content, or simply an AI companion without the constant censorship, this guide covers everything you need to make an informed choice.
